items.title: John Plumbe's end
items.reason: RECOMMENDED: John Plumbe took his own life. Suicide should not be in a rotation that can reach a child, and no rewrite makes it suitable. The classifier missed it because the wording avoided the word suicide.

items.title: Camp Hill
items.reason: RECOMMENDED: Camp Hill, 1856. At least sixty schoolchildren died when their excursion train caught fire. Children dying on a school outing is the single worst fit for a six-year-old audience in the whole corpus. The classifier rated it GENTLE_REWRITE; editorially it belongs here.

items.title: The Great Locomotive Chase
items.reason: Executed as spies. Removed per instruction. NOTE: consider releasing - the chase itself is a fine adventure story if the executions are simply omitted.

items.title: Best Friend of Charleston explodes
items.reason: Boiler explosion; two enslaved men injured, fireman died. Slavery plus graphic injury. Correctly out.

items.title: Killed by a snakehead
items.reason: Passenger impaled through the carriage floor by a broken rail. Graphic mechanism of death. Correctly out.

items.title: The B&O's chief engineer is killed
items.reason: Chief engineer thrown from a locomotive tender and killed. Correctly out, though milder than the others.
